issue.description: Implement secret-ruleset-v4 sections 2 and 4.4 (ADR-023 item 5): predicates P and Q in integer arithmetic; the credential-assignment rule with its identifier grammar, excluded identifiers, three forms, and value extraction; and the replacement advisory-keyword-assignment rule for values that fail Q. Acceptance: the section 7 item 2 truth table passes, with bead identifiers, names carrying a short hash, timestamps, versions, paths, camel-case names, and snake-case names false, and base62, labelled hexadecimal, and base64 values true; every excluded identifier is non-blocking, in particular a finding fingerprint that follows the acknowledge-secret option; environment names with a prefix, camel-case JSON keys, long options, and title-case labels with spaces block. Blocked by BR-T35 and BR-T39. Verify with the full Rust gates.
issue.notes:
Implemented deterministic integer P/Q qualifier and credential label normalization/assignment forms in src/scan/credential_shape.rs and structured_credentials.rs. Hashes, identifiers, timestamps, paths and reference prose remain non-blocking in independent truth-table/structure tests; labelled random candidates block without revealing values. Existing assignment redaction now preserves labels and replaces selected values. Independent review and full acceptance remain pending.
Final local verification (exported 7fef332 plus exact implementation files, not a release artifact): cargo fmt --check passed; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and the same command with --features managed-secret-policy passed. TMPDIR=/var/tmp cargo test --no-fail-fast passed 1,594 tests across 114 targets, zero failures, six ignored, including doctests. Git-specific exported-tree early returns do not prove the actual archive gate. Targeted managed command TMPDIR=/var/tmp cargo test --features managed-secret-policy --test secret_gap_contract --test cli_capabilities passed 27 tests. Whole checkout cargo test remains blocked by archive-build target mismatch beadrs-049cfb7b; fmt reports unrelated untracked checkpoint_resilience.rs and dependency_blocker_status.rs, preserved. No fleet pin, actual-secret purge, Git-history rewrite, or credential rotation was performed. Implementation owners stay open until outstanding whole-checkout gates pass; independent review and fleet acceptance are not self-approved.
Delivered repository implementation in main commit af3fe9c42c3e8f550193fab87d529506f1153ae0. Reservation returned for the outstanding verification/review owner; not closed or self-approved. BR-T46 depends on beadrs-049cfb7b for the real archive-build gate; BR-T47 remains blocked by BR-T46. Follow docs/plan/plan.md section 5.5 for the verified source scope and remaining acceptance.

Literal full-identifier exclusions precede normalization; apikey alias removed, whole keyword/suffix and64-byte boundaries enforced.
